meta.name: cellxgene-census
meta.description: Query the CZ CELLxGENE Census programmatically for versioned public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data. Use when you need population-scale cell metadata, gene expression slices, Census summary counts, source H5AD URIs/downloads, embeddings, spatial Census data, or reference atlas comparisons across organisms, tissues, diseases, assays, and cell types. For analyzing your own local single-cell data use scanpy, anndata, or scvi-tools.

copy.tagline: 查询单细胞和空间转录组学数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要编程查询大规模单细胞和空间转录组学数据。
copy.tagline_en: Query single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data programmatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically query large-scale single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以查询 CZ CELLxGENE Census 中的公开单细胞和空间转录组数据，包括细胞元数据、基因表达、数据集摘要、H5AD 文件链接、嵌入和空间数据。
howto.when: 当用户需要获取跨物种、组织、疾病、检测方法或细胞类型的单细胞数据，或进行大规模跨数据集分析时触发。

say.text: 查询人类肺组织中B细胞的基因表达数据。
say.note: 返回符合过滤条件的 AnnData 对象。

say.text: 统计大脑组织中主要细胞类型的数量。
say.note: 返回按细胞类型分组的计数。

say.text: 获取 COVID-19 患者 T 细胞的 CD4 和 CD8A 表达。
say.note: 返回指定基因的表达矩阵。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query the CZ CELLxGENE Census for public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data, including cell metadata, gene expression slices, summary counts, source H5AD URIs, embeddings, and spatial data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to retrieve single-cell data across organisms, tissues, diseases, assays, or cell types, or perform large-scale cross-dataset analyses.

say_en.text: Query gene expression data for B cells in human lung tissue.
say_en.note: Returns an AnnData object with filtered cells.

say_en.text: Count cell types in brain tissue.
say_en.note: Returns counts grouped by cell type.

say_en.text: Get CD4 and CD8A expression in T cells from COVID-19 patients.
say_en.note: Returns expression matrix for specified genes.
